name: s3-ontology
description: Entity-rich dialogue for the extraction before/after beat (used for both s3-default and s3-ontology). Exercises every ontology entity type, the Acme Cloud / AcmeCloud alias pair, the WORKS_AT/SUBSCRIBES_TO/USES patterns twice (support >= 2), and a scripted preference.

messages: Hi, I'm Maya Chen — I work at Northwind Robotics, and we're on the Pro plan. The Billing API charged us twice for Acme Cloud Compute again.
Ravi Shah also works at Northwind Robotics and he's on the Pro plan too — he reported the same duplicate-charge incident yesterday.
We use Acme Cloud Compute and the Acme Cloud Billing API in production. Honestly AcmeCloud has been great otherwise.
One more thing: I prefer email over phone for support follow-ups.
